scripts.build: bunx --bun tsc --noEmit && bunx --bun vite build && bun run bundle:check
scripts.apps:system:build: bun run --cwd apps/system/text-editor build && bun run --cwd apps/system/image-viewer build && bun run --cwd apps/system/media-viewer build && bun run --cwd apps/system/file-viewer build && bun run --cwd apps/system/terminal build && bun run --cwd apps/system/theme-editor build
scripts.apps:system: bun run apps:system:build && bun run app package apps/system/text-editor/dist dist/system-apps/text-editor.hiraya.app && bun run app package apps/system/image-viewer/dist dist/system-apps/image-viewer.hiraya.app && bun run app package apps/system/media-viewer/dist dist/system-apps/media-viewer.hiraya.app && bun run app package apps/system/file-viewer/dist dist/system-apps/file-viewer.hiraya.app && bun run app package apps/system/terminal/dist dist/system-apps/terminal.hiraya.app && bun run app package apps/system/theme-editor/dist dist/system-apps/theme-editor.hiraya.app
scripts.test:e2e: HIRAYA_FRONTEND_ONLY=true bun run build && playwright test
